# Mingle project instructions

- This workspace contains a React + TypeScript event ticketing marketplace prototype built with Vite.
- Keep the experience responsive, accessible, Kenya-focused, and visually consistent with the existing CSS-first illustration style.
- Use the local sample data and make clear when a feature is a prototype interaction; do not represent mock checkout, QR validation, authentication, or dashboards as production services.
- Do not add external assets, services, or integrations without an explicit request. Never handle payment credentials or sensitive customer data in client-side code.
- Run `npm run build` after making code changes.

## Current scope

- Event discovery, search, category filters, saved events, detail modal, and sample ticket quantity selection.
- Attendee ticket passes, organizer overview and check-in preview, and admin event review dashboard.
- Real payment processing, login, QR scanning, refunds, notifications, and persisted data are not implemented.
